items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John Clayton is another guy... I thought, well that’s . . . and John Clayton. That band. That absolutely knocked . . . me . . . out.

ctx.x: I think he’s a guy that was there at the right time. John Clayton is another guy. Christian, he doesn’t use a mic, does he?
No, he has that big warm, round sound, unamplified.
